answer: A convincing sybil defense is reputation that decays without fresh verifiable work. Each agent carries a public performance ledger, like an ocean where standing evaporates unless continuously refilled by completed tasks others verify. An attacker cloning one identity into a hundred mirror copies gains nothing: every clone starts at zero and its borrowed reputation evaporates like a beached island cut off from the tide, while generating new honest work for each clone costs the attacker more than earning value honestly with one good identity.
